title: feat: show Stream Avatars bridge health above the host
body:
## Summary

Operators can now check the Stream Avatars bridge connection above the host avatar. The indicator replaces the host's donation heart while displayed.

The original Extra Life animation confirms authenticated, fresh bridge traffic. A gold question mark covers connecting, disconnected, stale, or invalid-settings states. Both indicators display at half size in the host's heart position. Viewer hearts and host donation actions remain available. Missing settings disable connection attempts.

Freshness uses wall time, including paused game time. Absent hosts hide the indicator. Image failures preserve donation rendering. The original eight frames loop at five frames per second.

Closes #93. [Design and implementation record](https://github.com/stjohnjohnson/extralife-helper-bot/issues/93#issuecomment-6133339332).

## Release notes

- Stream Avatars displays a small animated Extra Life logo at the host's heart position when connected. A question mark indicates unconfirmed connectivity. Viewer hearts remain available.

## Upgrade actions

1. Run `npm run sa:package`.
2. Back up the companion's private connection settings.
3. Import `dist/stream-avatars/sa-helper-bridge.zip` into Stream Avatars.
4. Restore the private connection address.
5. Restore the private connection token.
6. Reconnect Stream Avatars or reload the companion with F5.

A stopped companion cannot update its indicator. Native graphical placement still requires an operator check.

## Validation

- `npm run lint`: passed.
- `npm test`: 64 suites and 1,391 tests passed.
- `npm run sa:package` and ZIP integrity: passed; 54 images.
- Installed Stream Avatars reader and typed metadata: 11 checks passed.
- Both required [CI checks](https://github.com/stjohnjohnson/extralife-helper-bot/actions/runs/38319760861) passed.
